changes.title: March on
items: When a soundsystem falls, the creatures that brought it down now head off quickly to attack the next one, instead of dawdling in their area

changes.title: Sigil floor
items: The grass round a placed sigil is trampled short instead of gone, so there's no dark patch behind it

changes.title: Put down hat
items: On the ground, hold the sigil button with nothing to pick up to put your hat down; press it over the hat to put it back on
